The rewrite also instructs the organizer to ‘Try opening the changing-room door with the film playing.’ The original describes what happens when that door opens and proposes a shade. It gives no instruction to run a door-opening trial.

The owner's account still comes before disassembly because handling can conceal the fault. Intake flags a leaking battery for the lead before it reaches the shared bench, and the qualified volunteer records the iron's final checks before release because moving the cord can mask trouble. The reference to the person ‘leading the morning’ adds incidental time of day but leaves the responsibility and deadline intact. Guided final stitches, the note for a replacement helper, testing at pickup and switching intake for the last quarter hour all retain their purposes.

The reminder in the original must go out ‘before harvest’ so donors know which plants to leave standing. The rewrite gives organizers until ‘before they pick their last pods for dinner,’ which permits sending the reminder after harvesting has started. The reason for leaving plants to mature survives, as do the checks on harvest dates, commercial seed labels and the visibility of the peas.

Both versions have staff reconcile the lending school's crates against the delivery record at the final collection when the kitchen reopens. The rewrite adds ‘When the six weeks are up,’ assigning the closure a duration the original never supplies. The trained receiver's food check before serving and the designated adult's matching of individual portions to children's records retain their actors and order.

The Moon must clear the local buildings during the gathering, and the invitation still specifies a fallback date and when and where to check the decision. Agreement on wording, credit and public use remains. The rewrite also strengthens the premise for the short web address from ‘Not everyone wants to install an app’ to ‘Few people want a new app,’ a claim about how common that preference is.

Local ensembles' answers guide initial selection. The short box code still connects problem reports, recovered pieces and photographs to the correct puzzle.
